authentication.source: Existing Secure/HttpOnly/Strict session cookie; verified server context only
authentication.child: path learnerId must equal verified actor learner_id
authentication.parent: unexpired parent elevation AND live non-revoked grant for path learnerId
authentication.originPolicy: Existing exact configured HTTPS origin and same-site policy; never trust forwarded headers

cache: Cache-Control: no-store; no service worker, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB or persistence
writes: ALL math writes disabled server-side; no reading saves, attempts, notes, rewards, entitlement, PIN or old service APIs
localInteraction: Camera, view buttons, temporary photos, six-step navigation only in component memory; reload resets; no correctness grading
assets: Reviewed compiled JSX inline SVG only. No raw SVG/HTML route or MIME extension; no remote images, printing, pet media or textbook PDFs.
csp: Keep current main CSP unchanged; no unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, external network, iframe, foreignObject, raw innerHTML or data URL exceptions

digestDefinition.sourceArtifactSha256: SHA256 of pinned complete source lessons.json; never serve that whole file
digestDefinition.publicDtoSha256: SHA256(canonical({lessonId,contentVersion,editorialRevision,sourceStatus,lesson})); excludes learner-specific envelope and manifest to avoid circular hashing
digestDefinition.visualSources: Exactly 8 reviewed visual source paths+source hashes in inventory (selectedSourcePaths excluding lessons.json); origin metadata is not a raw content URL
digestDefinition.visualArtifactSha256: SHA256(canonical(sorted [{path,sha256,sizeBytes}] of emitted first-lesson JS/CSS build assets)); verify against reviewed build manifest before enablement
